summary: Review lead magnets and gated assets for promise-to-value fit, proof, specificity, capture friction and whether the asset earns the requested user data.

must_inspect.why: The promised value must be concrete enough to justify attention and data capture.
false_positive_guards: Do not call a gate excessive solely because any form exists; evaluate requested commitment and context.

must_inspect.why: Data requested before access should be proportionate to the asset and downstream use.
false_positive_guards: Privacy/compliance conclusions require the relevant policy/legal evidence; keep the content finding bounded.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
